🇫🇮 ICEYE-X36 is a commercial synthetic aperture radar (SAR) microsatellite operated by ICEYE US (the U.S. subsidiary of the Finnish company ICEYE). 

- Launched: 4 March 2024 on a SpaceX Falcon 9 (Transporter-10) from Vandenberg Space Force Base. 

- Catalog: NORAD 59103 / COSPAR
